description: Read-only code reviews, design reviews and analyses by another agent family through Cowboy managed calls.
guidance: To have another agent review or analyze work (for example when asked to call {{peer}}), use Cowboy instead of running `codex exec`, `codex review` or `claude -p` yourself. Run `cowboy {{peer_command}} --request-file - [--preset ID]` with this JSON on stdin: {"schema":1,"request_id":"<new unique id>","purpose":"review|design_review|analysis","instruction":"<self-contained task>","context":{"scope":"current-worktree"},"access":"read-only","conversation":{"mode":"fresh"}}. It prints a JSON envelope with a call_id; then run `cowboy call wait <call_id>` until it is terminal and `cowboy call result <call_id>`. `cowboy call capabilities` reports whether calls are enabled and lists the preset ids (model and reasoning); omit --preset to use the session's choice. Reviews are optional and the user turns them on per session: when you have finished a substantive code change and are about to report, run `cowboy call capabilities`; if calls are enabled and {{peer}} is available, get a read-only review from {{peer}} first and fix or report its findings. If they are off, do not review and do not mention it. When the user explicitly asks for a call while calls are off, Cowboy asks them and the command waits for the answer; report a refusal instead of working around it.
